name: scroll-unroll
title: Scroll Unroll
description: A title unrolls like a scroll: a roller sweeps across, the letters rise in behind it, then it all rolls back up. Pure CSS keyframes.
label: yui540/css-animations
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>

props.name: children
props.description: The title, split into letters. Short titles (two to six characters) suit the roll best. It is announced once, as a whole.

props.name: key
props.description: Change it to remount and play the animation again.

props.name: ...props
props.description: Every native div attribute. className sizes the stage (default w-full max-w-80, square); aria-label names it.

a11y: The title is announced once, as a whole (a visually hidden copy); the animated letters are aria-hidden.
Right to left: the scroll follows the title's own direction (dir="auto"), so a right-to-left title unrolls from the left.
Reduced motion: opacity only. The line and the title fade in and out on the same timeline; the roll rests where it starts.
